name: word-rotate
title: Word Rotate
blurb: Words cycle in sequence, each fading in from top and out to bottom on a timer.
description: Displays one word at a time from a list, rotating continuously. Each transition fades the old word out (downward) and the new word in (from above).
use_when: Hero sections showing a list of attributes or values that should cycle automatically.
avoid_when: Accessibility-focused interfaces; looping animations are distracting and do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
a11y: Current word is always in the DOM and accessible; animation continuously cycles and does not pause with prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: motionProps
props.default: {initial: {opacity: 0, y: -50}, animate: {opacity: 1, y: 0}, exit: {opacity: 0, y: 50}, transition: {duration: 0.25, ease: "easeOut"}}
